name: South & East (Almaty · Shymkent · Tien Shan · Altai)

language.script_notes: Kazakh is more widely used in signage and speech in the south than in the north, alongside Russian in the big cities; Uzbek and Uyghur communities live near the southern border and in the southeast.

architecture.roof_style: Flat roofs on Soviet blocks; pitched metal roofs on houses; domes and minarets on mosques.
architecture.wall_construction: Soviet-era blocks with tree-lined avenues in Almaty; single-storey plastered houses behind fences with fruit orchards in the villages; Silk Road-style mausoleums and mosques in the south, including the mausoleum at Turkistan.
architecture.wall_color_palette: Pastel plaster and grey concrete, with turquoise domes on the mausoleums.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Soviet blocks and monuments along broad, tree-lined streets; the Turkistan mausoleum; village houses with orchards and shaded courtyards; snow-capped mountain backdrops to the cities.

nature.vegetation: Apple orchards and poplar-lined roads in the foothills, spruce forest and alpine meadows in the mountains, and dry steppe and semi-desert on the lowland plains of the south.
nature.terrain: The country's mountainous corner: the snow-capped Tien Shan and Zailiysky Alatau rise directly behind Almaty, with the Altai mountains in the far northeast and dry lowlands and deserts to the southwest.
nature.climate_signature: Warmer and greener than the north, with snow-capped peaks looming above the city.

vehicles.plate_format: Region codes such as 02 (Almaty city), 05 (Almaty region) and 17 (Shymkent) in the square on the right.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: Coverage centers on Almaty, Shymkent and the main highways; both Google and Yandex imagery exist in Almaty.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared Tien Shan mountain scenery, Soviet-era blocks and Cyrillic signage next to Almaty
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The extra Kazakh letters, plates with a light-blue flag and 'KZ' and Kazakh-language signs help separate the two.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared southern desert and mountain terrain and Central Asian culture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Cyrillic script and KZ plates here; Chinese signs and plates in Xinjiang, and different scripts and plates in Uzbekistan.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same country, same plates and script
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The southeast has snow-capped mountains, orchards and warmer weather; the north is flat cold steppe.
